name: Bots: olympiad
description: Phase 9 MVP A-D: Grand Olympiad nobles (roster 40, combat 3rd professions), gather at NPC 31688, fill live player queues, run bot vs bot, and fight in the stadium with class playstyles. Depends on bots-core (OlympiadPool) and bots-brain-basic for combat. Stock olympiad is unchanged when Enabled=false or bots-core is off.

Enabled.description: Olympiad bot roster and signup. Off = stock olympiad only (nobles already in the world idle-logout, in-progress matches are not aborted).

RosterSize.description: Target number of olympiad nobles (separate pool from hunter/trader bots). Extra rivals of a live player's class may go a little above this.

MinLevel.description: Lowest level of an olympiad noble.

MaxLevel.description: Highest level of an olympiad noble.

RivalsPerClass.description: When a live player waits in a classed queue, keep this many extra nobles of that class beyond the base quota.

SignUpChancePercent.description: When no live player is waiting: chance a free noble signs up to non-classed (bot vs bot) each signup pass.

RestSeconds.description: Seconds a noble waits after a match before it may sign up again.

RejoinParty.description: Reserved for MVP E (party hold). Unused in A-C.

GatherNpcId.description: Grand Olympiad Manager NPC the roster gathers around (stock 31688).
